//: What only Python has, added to the docstrings that scripts/python-api.mjs writes from the TSDoc comments (#29): the shapes and dtypes of the NumPy arrays. Keys are the Python names; a function gets {type, doc} as its Returns section, a constant a string as its last paragraph.

symcrys.LATTICE_SYMMETRY_DIRECTIONS: In Python: family → one int64 array of shape (n, 3) per position, the n directions [uvw] as rows.

operations.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``cartesian`` a float64 array of shape (n, 3, 3); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

generators.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``cartesian`` a float64 array of shape (n, 3, 3); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

lattice_basis.doc: A float64 array of shape (3, 3), a new array on each call; a, b, c are its columns.

describe_operations.doc: In each, ``axis`` (if present) has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

symmetry_directions.doc: Each entry of ``directions`` has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

wyckoff_positions.doc: In each, ``site_symmetry_operations`` is an int64 array of shape (n,).

tensor_form.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3, …, 3), each allowed tensor with its rank axes; ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank); ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), rows r with r @ t.reshape(-1) == 0 for every allowed tensor t; ``rank``. p is the number of free parameters.

tensor_form_of.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3, …, 3), each allowed tensor with its rank axes; ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank); ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), rows r with r @ t.reshape(-1) == 0 for every allowed tensor t; ``rank``. p is the number of free parameters.

rotate_tensor.doc: A float64 array of the shape of ``tensor`` (shape (3, …, 3), or flat (3**rank,)), with the stacks of ``tensor`` and ``rotation`` (leading axes, broadcast as in NumPy) in front: a rotation of shape (k, 3, 3) rotates the tensor k times, a stack of tensors (m, 3, …, 3) is rotated each.

orbit.doc: In each, ``hkl`` (or ``uvw``) is an int64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,). Give ``hkl=`` for a face or ``uvw=`` for a lattice direction.

orbit_of.doc: In each, ``direction`` is a float64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,).

wyckoff_position.doc: ``site_symmetry_operations`` is an int64 array of shape (n,).

site_symmetry_of.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

residual_operations.doc: The kept operations of the caller, in their order.

symcrys.magnetic.LATTICE_SYMMETRY_DIRECTIONS: In Python: family → one int64 array of shape (n, 3) per position, the n directions [uvw] as rows.

operations.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``cartesian`` a float64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``time_reversal`` a bool array of shape (n,); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

generators.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``cartesian`` a float64 array of shape (n, 3, 3), ``time_reversal`` a bool array of shape (n,); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

describe_operations.doc: In each, ``axis`` (if present) has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

symmetry_directions.doc: Each entry of ``directions`` has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

tensor_form.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3, …, 3), each allowed tensor with its rank axes; ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank); ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), rows r with r @ t.reshape(-1) == 0 for every allowed tensor t; ``rank``. p is the number of free parameters.

tensor_form_of.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3, …, 3), each allowed tensor with its rank axes; ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank); ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), rows r with r @ t.reshape(-1) == 0 for every allowed tensor t; ``rank``. p is the number of free parameters.

rotate_tensor.doc: A float64 array of the shape of ``tensor`` (shape (3, …, 3), or flat (3**rank,)), with the stacks of ``tensor`` and ``rotation`` (leading axes, broadcast as in NumPy) in front: a rotation of shape (k, 3, 3) rotates the tensor k times, a stack of tensors (m, 3, …, 3) is rotated each.

orbit.doc: In each, ``hkl`` (or ``uvw``) is an int64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,). Give ``hkl=`` for a face or ``uvw=`` for a lattice direction.

orbit_of.doc: In each, ``direction`` is a float64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,).

site_symmetry_of.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

residual_operations.doc: The kept operations of the caller, in their order.

plane_group.doc: ``centring`` is a float64 array of shape (n, 2), n = 0 or 1.

operations.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 2, 2), ``translation`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

generators.doc: ``matrix`` an int64 array of shape (n, 2, 2), ``translation`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2); ``ops[i]`` and ``for op in ops`` give one operation as a dict.

describe_operations.doc: ``translation``, ``location`` and ``glide`` (where present) are float64 arrays of shape (2,), ``direction`` and ``axis`` int64 arrays of shape (2,).

describe_operations_of.doc: As ``describe_operations``: ``translation``, ``location`` and ``glide`` (where present) float64 arrays of shape (2,), ``direction`` and ``axis`` int64 arrays of shape (2,).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``point`` float64 array of shape (2,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

wyckoff_distances.doc: One per Wyckoff position, in the order of ``wyckoff_positions``: ``letter``, ``multiplicity``, ``site_symmetry``, ``coordinates`` as there, ``point`` a float64 array of shape (2,) and ``distance`` a float.

orbit.doc: In each, ``point`` is a float64 array of shape (2,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,).

asymmetric_unit.doc: ``inequalities`` an int64 array of shape (m, 3), ``vertices`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2), ``edges`` an int64 array of shape (n,), indices into ``inequalities``.

symmetry_elements.doc: ``rotation_points``: dicts ``{"n", "point"}``, point a float64 array of shape (2,); ``lines``: dicts ``{"kind", "direction", "axis", "glide", "point"}``, direction and axis int64 of shape (2,), glide and point float64 of shape (2,).
